coverage.reason: The unchanged Windows-only real unlink-denial test is inapplicable on Linux. The runner correctly reports a coverage gap rather than all-pass.

assertions.title: audio uses a fixed native-recognized suffix while opaque IDs, identity checks and retained history survive restart
unsupported audio is refused and new audio rollback removes its exact suffixed storage
legacy extensionless audio remains readable but must be reuploaded before native audio transmission
history media reads only exact indexed paths retained by the requested thread
uploads and restores the complete 4 MiB boundary with every Base64 padding length
malformed, noncanonical and oversized Base64 never writes an attachment
restart preserves file identity, digest and thread pins
rejected reservations release only their own uncommitted thread references
an overlapping accepted or unknown reservation prevents another rejection from unpinning it
replaced regular files, hard links, modified bytes and oversized content are rejected before exposing content
a pathname swapped after lstat is rejected by opened file identity
read growth is bounded and a replaced directory is rejected
orphans and pending files consume physical byte and count quotas across restart
directory iteration fails at a fixed entry budget without materializing an unbounded listing
symlink and FIFO substitutions never follow or block
read-only native data group never gains metadata or directory write access
real OS unlink denial leaves a durable tombstone and quota charge until restart can delete

boundaries: Linux symlink and FIFO substitutions reject without follow or blocking.
The opened-descriptor check rejects a path swapped after lstat; growth and replaced directory are rejected.
Actual Linux attachment directory/data/index modes are 02750/0640/0600 with expected group.
Fixed supported audio suffix, restart retention and exact thread-owned history media reads pass.
Base64/4MiB/count/physical byte quotas and overlapping accepted/unknown attachment pins pass.

isolation.source: Fresh random /var/tmp directory, complete source/protocol/test runner, original test unchanged.
isolation.network: unshare --net with no external interface; unprivileged runuser and clean environment.
isolation.dependencies: Copied only third-party node_modules from existing staging into the new fixture. Every declared direct dependency version matched the new package.json; no previous application source was inspected.
isolation.production: No systemd, online instance, fixed launcher or existing helper mutation; fixture materials retained.

limits: The Windows-only unlink-denial case was not executed in this Linux run; no combined cross-platform zero-skip claim is made.
These are targeted attachment file/identity tests, not a full gateway/native cross-UID media integration.
Critical source and test bytes matched the local files immediately after execution. Other agents may continue changing the repository.
